summary: Retest of post-iteration-5 fixes. All 7 fixes verified. New backend suite test_iteration6_fixes.py 12/12 PASS; full regression 97/97 PASS (incl. iteration5 tests 11/15/16 that previously failed). Frontend smoke PASS: Cardápio editor tabs Básico/Ficha/Preço (non-pizza + pizza Base + per-flavor tabs, cost calc correct), mode switch revenda->none clears stock_item_id/tracks_stock and preserves pronto_item_id, Produção dialog for pronto non-pizza and pizza (flavor required, preview correct: 0.6kg farinha + 0.4kg queijo = R$19,00), Descarte via UI (2->1), Caixa (caixa1) pizza meio-a-meio sale + checkout + receipt, pronto flavor decremented 1->0.5 and flavor without pronto skipped. No page errors.

minor.issue: No cascade on production_batches: deleting a pronto product/pronto estoque item leaves orphan batches with quantity_remaining>0 that still appear in Produção > Lotes with an active 'Descartar' button (descarte then $inc's a non-existent estoque item). Observed TEST_Pizza_dc6c1 batches left after pytest teardown.
When both item_id and item_type are passed, item_type overwrites the item_id filter (q['item_id'] reassigned). Should intersect.

Decrement is capped by batch sum, so if pronto item quantity was raised via manual 'entrada/ajuste' movimento (no batch), sales never decrement that extra stock. Consider blocking manual movimentos on type=pronto or creating a batch for them.
Still requires 'name' (EstoqueItemIn.name required) -> partial PATCH without name returns 422. Works for current UI which sends full form.

issues: Pizza card cost line 'custo R$ 5,50 · 100%' wraps onto 2 lines and looks cramped next to price
Validade uses native <input type=date> (browser picker) instead of shadcn Calendar
Header shows 'PADARIA TRADIÇÃO' while app brand/footer is 'Assunção & Paladini' - inconsistent store name
'Item de revenda vinculado' select and 'Unidades por venda' input lack data-testid

action_items: Cascade/guard production_batches when a pronto product or pronto estoque item is deleted (or hide/disable descartar for orphan batches)
GET /estoque/movimentos: combine item_id and item_type filters instead of overwriting
Decide policy for manual movimentos on pronto items (block or create batch) so pronto qty stays in sync with batches
Minor: add data-testid to revenda stock select & stock_usage input; fix pizza cost line wrap; unify receipt store name
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /products uses full model_dump: any client that omits pronto_item_id will null it and orphan the pronto stock (current Cardápio spreads product so it's preserved - verified)
server.py is 1590+ lines - split into routers (estoque, producao, orders)
create_batch consumes insumos with non-atomic read/validate/then $inc - concurrent productions can drive insumo negative
